description: Source code implementing the Keccak-1600 permutation and related functions for cryptographic hashing, specifically for SHA-3 and SHAKE algorithms, within the BoringSSL library.

methods.name: keccak_f
methods.description: Performs the Keccak-1600 permutation on the state array, implementing θ, ρ, π, χ, and ι steps.

methods.name: keccak_init
methods.description: Initializes the Keccak context with input data and parameters based on the selected hash or shake configuration.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak
methods.description: Computes the Keccak hash or shake output for given input data.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_init
methods.description: Initializes the Keccak context with input data for subsequent squeezing.

methods.name: BORINGSSL_keccak_squeeze
methods.description: Extracts output bytes from the Keccak state after absorption.
